remarks: Great investment opportunity! Discover the potential in this high ranch-style home located on a desirable corner lot in Greenwich. Featuring 2 bedrooms and 1 bathroom, this home offers classic charm with hardwood floors throughout and a fireplace in the living room-perfect for cozy evenings. The walk-up attic provides excellent potential to be finished into a third bedroom or additional living space, adding to the home's value. A 2-car attached garage offers convenience, while the stucco siding gives the exterior a timeless look. While the property is dated and in need of updates and repairs, it's a fantastic investment opportunity for buyers looking to add their personal touch. With easy access to highways and a prime location, this home is well worth the effort. Bring your vision and some elbow grease-this one won't last long!
